hero.title: Stand together with New Haiti 2075
hero.subtitle: Share your contact details so we can keep you updated about projects, events, opportunities, and community activities.
hero.highlight: When you complete this form, you officially become a member of HAITI 2075 — because our strength grows when we work together. Let’s rebuild Haiti with pride and dignity.

form.title: Become a community member

form.successMessage: Thank you for joining the movement! You’ll receive a confirmation email shortly.
